notes.title: Surprise release - we're out now!
notes.notes:
Hello Familia!

The wait is finally over, Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Infinite Combate is now available on Steam!

Fight alongside the weak but brave Bell, or the strong Aiz in the Dungeon!

You can also craft gear, discover exclusive parts of the story, and even go to dates with your favorite waifus!

And Hestia was able to haggle with Hephaestus, so Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Infinite Combat will be available with 20% off during a week!

See you soon in Orario!

notes.title: Release Date Delay
notes.notes:
Hello Familia, 

We're sorry to announce that there has been a slight delay in the development, which means that we won't be able to release the game this Friday. We are hoping this will be only a short delay and that the game will be out in the next 1-3 weeks. We will keep you updated as soon as we have a firm date.

notes.title: Release Date Confirmed!
notes.notes:
Hello Familia, 

We're happy to announce that Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls In A Dungeon? Infinite Combate is releasing on Steam worldwide on August 7 2020! 
Our new release date trailer is getting uploaded to the store page now, but you can also find it [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vhl1nQp27UA]here[/url]! 

You can also follow all our news on @PQubeAsia on Twitter or Facebook!

notes.title: Release Window
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

As there have been a lot of speculations regarding what is happening with the release of DanMachi on PC. We have in fact not announced a firm release date. The English Asian release on consoles was earlier in the year, but the PC version will be aligned with the console release in the West. 
As it happens, we have had some development delays as the staff in Japan has had to start working remotely due to the COVID-19 outbreak, and this has pushed back the game's release to this summer. 
We are almost ready to announce the final release date for the game, but in the mean time, please bear with us and we apologise for any lack of clarity in the process.
Here is an image of Hestia the Bestia to appease you.
